player_prompt.intro:
O wewe usolula o kuxinga ka Sokoban. O wewe ng'eji, o wewe usolula kusola malundu yoso ku malengo.
        Wewe wakala pamba na kamba, o wewe usolula kamba kwa kusola mu mwelekeo umwe.
        O wewe kau solula kamba kwa kamba kupita kamba, o wewe kau solula kamba.
        Pa tabuleiro, bantu yoso bantu yoso bantu yoso bantu yoso:
        - O ng'eji (wewe) ufwile 'P' 
        - Kamba zisola na '#'
        - Malundu masola 'X'
        - Malengo amwele 'O'
        - Malundu pa malengo masola '√'
        O wewe usolula kamba kwa kutumia [w] kwa ju, [a] kwa kushoto, [s] kwa kushuka, na [d] kwa kulia.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Kimbila kiaku kimenekenekele mu ndinga ya kufua. Usa [up], [down], [left], [right] ou [w], [a], [s], [d].
invalid_move.not_valid_action: O ku bhanga kiki, ki kua-nda tu bhulula.
invalid_move.wall_collision: Eie ku tena kuia bhu kididi kiki!
invalid_move.invalid_position: O ku bhiluka kuku, ki kua tokala kubhita mu kididi kiki.

outcome.win: Nga mi sakidila, mukonda mua tena ku batula o maka a Sokoban!
outcome.turn_limit: O jimbandu ja ku sokejeka o ima, ki ji tena dingi kuenda kiambote.
